name: Piercer
summary: +1 Str or Dex; reroll one Piercing damage die once per turn, and roll an extra die on Piercing Critical Hits.

benefits.name: Puncture
benefits.summary: Once per turn, reroll one damage die of a Piercing hit; use the new roll.
benefits.text: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals Piercing damage, you can reroll one of the attack's damage dice, and you must use the new roll.

benefits.name: Enhanced Critical
benefits.summary: Piercing Critical Hits roll one additional damage die.
benefits.text: When you score a Critical Hit that deals Piercing damage to a creature, you can roll one additional damage die when determining the extra Piercing damage the target takes.
